entries.name: Safe job analysis before start-up
entries.description: A safe job analysis is held with the crew before a non-routine operation starts, and the controls it names are in place before the first step.
entries.performanceRequirement: Signed by the crew and the supervisor before the operation starts, and kept with the job record.

entries.name: Permit to work
entries.description: Work carried out under a permit to work with the stated precautions in force.

entries.name: Physical guarding
entries.description: Fixed guarding or barriers preventing access to the hazard during operation.

entries.name: Remote operation of the equipment
entries.description: Operate the equipment remotely so no one is stationed at it.

entries.name: Fire watch
entries.description: A named person watches the hot-work area during and after the work.

entries.name: Hearing protection
entries.description: Hearing protection selected for the measured noise dose over the shift.

entries.name: Hot work certificate
entries.reference: Insurer's safety regulations for hot work
